why: The scenario revisions ARE lane B's test fixture: they are the 'before' and 'after' code the app compares. The tests and app.cli resolve them by name, so deleting these branches breaks the suite. Read this before deleting them again.
recreate: git push origin ref/scenario1-head:refs/heads/scenario1-head   # from the tag, for each name

anchor.why_a_tag_not_a_branch: base is a FROZEN snapshot. Anchoring the scenarios on a moving branch (main) would make their diffs start showing reversions of later work, so the 'diff = one file' property would decay. The tag is immutable and keeps that property forever.
anchor.note: scenario1-head..scenario4-head still exist as branches because they are the 'after' revisions the demo compares. The 'before' revision is now the tag.
